serviceability_stress_buffer.framework: Prudential Practice Guide APG 223 Residential Mortgage Lending
serviceability_stress_buffer.description: ADIs must evaluate borrower debt serviceability against a minimum interest rate buffer of at least 3.00% above the product contract rate.

lenders_mortgage_insurance.description: Lenders Mortgage Insurance (LMI) is typically levied by Australian lenders on home loans with a Loan-to-Value Ratio (LVR) exceeding 80%.
